Name: Better Fish Pond
Author: po0pfart
Description:
Take full control of your fish pond. This mod lets you customize how every fish behaves in a pond, including spawn speed, production rates, outputs, and population limits.

This mod works with vanilla fish and modded fish, so it's compatible with large content mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url].

Features:

[list]
[*]Individual spawn time - control how fast fish reproduce in ponds
[*]Individual produce chance - control the chance for fish to produce item each day
[*]Toggle population gates - choose if each fish must complete pond item quest to increase population
[*]Custom fish pond product - choose what items each fish can produce
[*]Adjustable produce quantity - control how many items are produced at once
[/list]All features are configurable through [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url]. Each fish can be customized individually.
